source.title: Fantasy Court: The Case against Rashee Rice
source.author: Fantasy Footballers
source.summary: The negative side of a deliberately two-sided player debate.

takeaways.label: avoid
takeaways.summary: Availability risk, an elevated price and a changing Kansas City offense make Rice difficult to trust.
takeaways.rationale: Availability risk, an elevated price and a changing Kansas City offense make Rice difficult to trust.
risks: His proven target-earning ability can still overcome those concerns.
